required_condition: dimension-anchor gate is present and identifies the missing source-law layer
velocity dimension must be sourced by a source-side law before any formula or numeric row exists
candidate anchors must be source-side dimensioned carriers rather than fitted velocity residuals
coefficient and scale policies remain separate from the anchor-source choice
a pre-scoring basis must list admissible anchor candidates and rejection rules
candidate basis and later anchor choice cannot be selected from endpoint scores or residual fit quality
